mapper.sql: select s.sales_order_id, s.sales_order_no, s.customer_id, s.customer_name, s.order_date, s.delivery_date, s.total_qty, s.total_amount, s.order_status, d.item_summary, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark from erp_sales_order s left join ( select sales_order_id, group_concat(concat_ws(' / ', sku_code, style_no, style_name, color_name, size_name, order_qty) order by sales_order_detail_id separator '; ') as item_summary from erp_sales_order_detail group by sales_order_id ) d on d.sales_order_id = s.sales_order_id
mapper.select:
and s.sales_order_no like concat('%', #{salesOrderNo}, '%') and s.customer_name like concat('%', #{customerName}, '%') and s.order_status = #{orderStatus}
order by s.order_date desc, s.sales_order_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into erp_sales_order(sales_order_no, customer_id, customer_name, order_date, delivery_date, total_qty, total_amount, order_status, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{salesOrderNo}, #{customerId}, #{customerName}, #{orderDate}, #{deliveryDate}, #{totalQty}, #{totalAmount}, #{orderStatus}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from erp_sales_order where sales_order_id in #{salesOrderId}
